statement: The fifteen screens hold 177,039 numeric yield measurements of 2,207 substrate pairs built from 794 distinct molecular structures, 97.9% of the 180,879 cells of their pair-by-condition grids.
A further 378 designed cells have no yield (product detected but not quantifiable, 90; no screen record, 288), and 74 measurements are the second copy of one duplicated Hiyama condition
These records include 90 that carry an inherited quality-check flag

Over 74 substrate pairs the two copies correlate at r = 0.95 on raw yield; on the slope-adjusted condition pattern their agreement, the mean product of the two copies divided by their mean square, is 0.67 (Pearson r = 0.72)

The release contains 244,179 numeric yield measurements: 177,039 from the fifteen screens, 74 from the second copy of the duplicated Hiyama condition (Supplementary Note 2), 36,499 from the 420 Set A pairs that enter the record-transfer test, the three-condition decision or the ownership estimate, and 30,567 from the 535 Set B pairs (Supplementary Note 10).

Every well of these units is listed with its measurement status: quantified (a numeric yield); zero by rule (the screen found no product and the well was not chromatographed; yield 0); product detected but not quantified (the product peak overlapped another peak or the internal standard integrated abnormally; no yield); or no screen record (no yield).

The 1,192 conditions named by these records are given with their full recorded compositions, and the 401 reagent entries referenced in their reagent slots with their identities; solvent identities are provided directly in the condition table.
It also lists all 442 pairs, without yields, with the eligibility of each.
Of the released measurements, 42,671 also occur in the amide-coupling collection of Zhang *et al.* (33), and parts also appear in other public releases of the same corpus by our group.
